primary_endpoint: Hepatic histological improvement in NAS by ≥2 points, with at least a 1-point reduction in lobular inflammation or hepatocellular ballooning and no worsening of fibrosis at Year 1.
efficacy_outcome: At Year 1, 23 participants receiving CVC versus 27 receiving placebo met the endpoint (p=0.5194).
safety_signal: Serious AEs affected 25/144 in the CVC/CVC group, 8/72 in the placebo/CVC group, and 12/72 in the placebo/placebo group; no deaths were reported.
